nodes.summary: For a prime $p$, there are positive integers $a \le b \le c$ with $p \nmid a$, $p \mid b$, $p \mid c$ and $4/p = 1/a + 1/b + 1/c$ if and only if there are positive integers $q$, $r$, $s_1$, $s_2$ with $q \equiv 3 \pmod 4$, both $s_1$ and $s_2$ dividing $(q + 1)/4$, and $p + 4 s_1 s_2 = qr$.
nodes.title: Chamberland's characterization of restricted Erdős–Straus representations

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and let $x \le y \le z$ be positive integers with $4/p = 1/x + 1/y + 1/z$ and $p \nmid y$. Then $\lceil p/4 \rceil \le x \le \lceil p/2 \rceil$, and there is a positive divisor $d$ of $x^2$ with $d \equiv -px \pmod{4x - p}$, $(4x - p)\,y = px + d$ and $(4x - p)\,d\,z = px(px + d)$.
nodes.title: Divisor criterion necessary for type I Erdős–Straus solutions

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and let $x$ be a natural number with $\lceil p/4 \rceil \le x \le \lceil p/2 \rceil$. If $d$ is a positive divisor of $x^2$ with $d \equiv -px \pmod{4x - p}$, then there are natural numbers $y$ and $z$ with $(4x - p)\,y = px + d$ and $(4x - p)\,d\,z = px(px + d)$ such that $x \le y \le z$ and $p \nmid y$.
nodes.title: Type I Erdős–Straus triples from divisors of a square

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and let $x \le y \le z$ be positive integers with $4/p = 1/x + 1/y + 1/z$ and $p \mid y$. Then $\lceil p/4 \rceil \le x \le \lceil p/2 \rceil$, and there is a positive divisor $d$ of $x^2$ with $d \le x$, $d \equiv -x \pmod{4x - p}$, $(4x - p)\,y = p(x + d)$ and $(4x - p)\,d\,z = px(x + d)$.
nodes.title: Divisor criterion necessary for type II Erdős–Straus solutions

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
